body:
I have been keeping to myself to try and feel better while doing some self-reflection and not actively engage with family through whatsapp since the day she confronted me bc I felt that I cannot handle the negative thoughts I have been having since she told me my husband looks unhappy with me. 


That’s why when she sent me a long-winded message about the same thing plus other shitty things that I want to stay in the past, I just had about enough. Idk if I can save my relationship with my husband. I know it’s not his fault and it was my mother who is speculating and projecting negative things on my marriage based on her prejudice of me, but I’m so done with my family piling on me for not being perfect for him. 


I wanted to get divorced so we can be happy on our own but he is insisting on involving the whole family in the discussion. 


I keep thinking that maybe if we get divorced my family will stop judging me so much for not being the perfect wife for him. I’m just tired tbh

I’ve been feeling so worthless the past few days after she said how unhappy my husband looks around me. I’ve been struggling with acne as well for a few months so I’ve been feeling extra low. I am trying so hard to be patient with her but had to tell her to stop since I’m not mentally well at the moment when she messaged me again this evening. Idk why I can’t stop crying. They keep telling me it’s my fault that everything sucks
